jobs.name: sequoia
jobs.prompt: Rendered miniature from a museum collection. Broad upper-left/front light, readable textured materials and dark recesses, gentle purple ambient bounce. Square genuine transparent PNG; complete isolated object, no cast shadow, wall, shelf, scenery, plinth or visible support. Center subject; longest solid dimension 93% of canvas, all extremities clear of edges. No text. Edit the sequoia in image 1 into a FRONT VIEW of a small realistic mature giant sequoia model on an invisible shelf just below eye level. Straight-on trunk, almost orthographic with very little perspective. Gently looking down only 5 degrees, no high aerial view. Preserve its character: massive reddish cinnamon deeply furrowed buttressed trunk, branching evergreen crown, rich green foliage and warm sunlit needles. Show complete root flare terminating naturally as a detached tree, no soil disk or ground. The canopy must look like a giant sequoia, not a stylized Christmas tree or tiny bonsai. Preserve dense irregular foliage but make trunk readable. Complete crown and roots unclipped.

jobs.name: great-sphinx
jobs.prompt: Rendered miniature from a museum collection. Broad upper-left/front light, readable textured materials and dark recesses, gentle purple ambient bounce. Square genuine transparent PNG; complete isolated object, no cast shadow, wall, shelf, scenery, plinth or visible support. Center subject; longest solid dimension 93% of canvas, all extremities clear of edges. No text. Edit Great Sphinx of Giza in image 1 into a true SIDE PROFILE, as a small museum souvenir displayed on an invisible shelf. Head faces SCREEN LEFT, elongated reclining lion body runs horizontally to the right; long forepaws extend left, tail curves along rear body. Exact side view, zero yaw toward camera: only profile of human face and nemes headdress, missing nose, one near-side flank dominant, far paws largely hidden directly behind near paws. Very weak perspective, slight downward view around 5 degrees, narrow top surfaces only. Preserve weathered golden limestone layers, erosion and carving detail, authentic proportions and integral narrow bedrock underside. No separate pedestal, no environment. Keep full forepaws and tail visible.
